commands: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path "bench-orch\alpha.txt")) { exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path "bench-orch\beta.txt")) { exit 1 }; Write-Output "OK: alpha.txt + beta.txt exist""

notes: Edit workspace.sourcePath so it points at the repo or template you want Codex to work inside.
Edit the scenarios so they match real tasks instead of generic starter prompts.
Benchmark means real codex exec runs now. There is no simulated dry-run mode.
setupQuestions: What are the 3 highest-value real tasks this plugin should help complete inside a workspace?
Which scenario is the must-pass end-to-end task for this plugin?
What output should exist on disk if the scenario succeeds?
Which verification command would tell you the result is actually usable?
What boundary case should this plugin narrow, refuse, or hand off instead of overreaching on?

scenarios.title: Parallel independent writes
scenarios.purpose: Decompose two independent write tasks and run them in parallel visible windows; measure real token usage of the orchestrator.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local plugin "codex-tui-orchestrator". In this workspace, create two independent files: alpha.txt containing ALPHA (UTF-8) and beta.txt containing BETA (UTF-8). These are independent and must run as separate visible parallel Codex TUI windows.
successChecklist: The orchestrator decomposes into two independent blocks (alpha.txt, beta.txt).
Both files are created on disk with the correct content.
The run uses --run-windows (visible windows), not headless.

scenarios.title: Serial dependent write
scenarios.purpose: Measure the linked/serial path: a second task depends on the first.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local plugin "codex-tui-orchestrator". In this workspace, create a file plan.md containing the text "done", then create summary.md that contains the full text read back from plan.md (so summary.md depends on plan.md). These are dependent; run them serialized.
successChecklist: The orchestrator detects plan.md -> summary.md dependency and serializes.
Both files exist; summary.md contains plan.md content.
The run finishes and reports the captured result.

scenarios.title: Boundary: refuse headless
scenarios.purpose: Verify the plugin narrows scope and does not do headless real execution.
scenarios.userInput: This task is a weak match for "codex-tui-orchestrator": just read-only summarize the repo README. Do not do any real write. Explain the boundary (read-only stays inline, no window).
successChecklist: No real execution / no window is spawned for a read-only task.
The read-only summary is given inline.
